subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We are planning to see an ____________ perform a symphony.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Orchestra)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Orchestra"** refers to a large group of musicians who play various musical instruments together, often led by a conductor, especially for classical music performances. (वाद्यवृंद)

 
 
• **Example:** The orchestra performed a beautiful rendition of Beethoven's symphony.
 
 
 
• The word **"Opera"** refers to a dramatic work combining text (libretto) and musical score, often performed in a theatrical setting, with singers and musicians. (संगीत नाटक)
 
 
• **Example:** The opera singer captivated the audience with her powerful voice.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the context of the sentence, seeing an orchestra perform a symphony is the most appropriate option.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Orchestra)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Opera** (संगीत नाटक): A theatrical performance that combines music and drama, typically with singers and an orchestra.

 
 
• **Example:** She went to see an opera at the grand theater.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Actor** (अभिनेता): A person who performs roles in plays, movies, or television shows.
 
 
• **Example:** The actor delivered a stunning performance in the movie.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Actress** (अभिनेत्री): A female performer who acts in plays, movies, or television shows.
 
 
• **Example:** The actress won an award for her brilliant portrayal of the character.
